title: Beyone the Happy Path: Josh Clark & Veronica Veronika on "Sentient Design"
author: Commit & Push
summary: Host Damien Filiatrault welcomes Josh Clark and Veronika Kindred—principal and researcher at Big Medium and co-authors of the forthcoming book Sentient Design—for a cross-generational look at how AI changes product and UX. They unpack what “sentient” really means in interfaces, why defensive design matters more than ever, and how to let intelligence co-pilot the presentation layer without giving up control.
